page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.xlarge belongs to the High Clock Speed instance family, running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture. It provides 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6149 processor operating at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz. Memory capacity totals 16.0 GB, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU core.

The instance does not include local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of network-backed cloud block storage for persistent data and operating system volumes. There are no hardware accelerators or GPUs included. Networking is configured with a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires explicit allocation of network routing or Elastic IP resources for external connectivity.

With its elevated 3.1 GHz CPU clock speed paired with a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the ecs.hfg5.xlarge provides predictable compute capacity without resource contention. It is applicable for general-purpose workloads sensitive to single-thread latency, such as web application hosting, build systems, continuous integration pipelines, and small-to-medium enterprise relational databases.
